dataset: DeepStruc experimental PDF JQ_S1: colloidal Pt nanoparticles (surfactant-free synthesis, J. Quinson samples), DESY Sep 2017; xPDFsuite G(r), Qmax 21.998 (qmaxinst 22), Qmin 1.0, wavelength 0.1 A
licence: Apache-2.0 (DeepStruc repository licence covering included data); Kjaer E.T.S., Anker A.S. et al. (2023) DeepStruc, Digital Discovery

concord.command: uv run python -W ignore -m concord.cli analyze <folder> --fast

verdict: Concord picks fcc Pt (Rw 0.116) with a = 3.9329 A (+0.23% vs 3.924 A) and a 3.3 nm spherical-envelope diameter, consistent with few-nm Pt nanoparticles. Caveats: Pt3Co (L1_2, an fcc superstructure) is a near-tie at Rw 0.125 since X-rays barely separate it from Pt for a Pt-only composition; qdamp was assumed (0.04), which affects the envelope/size and U_iso more than a.
